summary: Full-stack testing of v3 features: Place Order screen end-to-end (low-stock banner -> /place-order -> grouped products -> sort toggle -> select -> POST /api/purchase-orders -> navigation to /orders), backend PUT for warehouses/categories/suppliers, Catalog A-Z/By stock sort toggle, and Settings edit + delete CRUD. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_v3_features.py with 7 new pytest cases — all 7 PASS. Full backend regression: 36/36 PASS (16 original + 13 prior + 7 new). Frontend: Playwright mobile-viewport (390x844) walked the full flow on the public preview URL. Result: 1) Dashboard low-stock-warning banner renders with 'Place Order' button (testID place-order-btn) -> navigates to /place-order. 2) Place Order screen renders sort-stock + sort-name chips, groups products under 'OUT OF STOCK (1)' header, checkbox selection toggles, Create Purchase Order footer appears with selected count, POST creates PO and replaces route to /orders where the new PO appears in Order History. 3) Catalog has catalog-sort-name + catalog-sort-stock toggles working alongside category chips + search. 4) Settings: add-warehouses opens modal with name + address fields; edit-warehouses-<id> pre-fills modal (verified f1='UI_TEST_WH', f2='UI Addr 1'); Save -> PUT updates the name to 'UI_TEST_WH_EDITED' (visible in list); del-warehouses-<id> removes it. Categories modal correctly hides the second field. No red-screen / pageerror events.

minor.issue: On a non-matching id (other-user or 404), all three silently no-op and return 200 with the echoed body instead of 404. Safe (no cross-tenant write, verified by isolation test) but a 404 would be clearer client feedback.
Pre-existing benign startup warning 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' (carried over from previous iterations).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning at runtime: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted by a third-party RN component during render. Cosmetic only on web preview; no functional impact. Reference: emitted on every screen mount.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Return 404 from PUT /api/warehouses/{id}, /api/categories/{id}, /api/suppliers/{id} when matched_count == 0 (currently silently echoes back a 200 — confirmed not a security issue but clearer ergonomics).

(Optional) place-order.tsx always sends warehouse_id = warehouses[0]?.id; if the user has multiple warehouses this picks the first one without a chooser. Consider adding a warehouse picker on the Place Order footer.
(Optional, low priority) Investigate source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN Web warning — it is harmless but noisy in browser console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~640 lines now (single file). Approaching the 700-line split threshold; recommend extracting models / auth / routers when next feature lands.

POCreate (line 565) does not enforce that product_ids belong to the calling user, but the products query is correctly scoped by owner_id in the find() call (line 573) — so per-tenant isolation is preserved (verified by test_po_isolation).

place-order.tsx line 60: `warehouse_id: warehouses[0]?.id || null` — relies on first warehouse, no UI for choosing. Works for the common case (Main Warehouse seeded on register) but does not support multi-warehouse users.

settings.tsx save() (line 35) sends address/email even for empty strings; backend accepts string|None so empty strings are persisted as empty rather than dropped. Minor — consider trimming to None when empty.
settings.tsx delete is destructive without confirmation dialog — acceptable for an internal admin tool but a Confirm modal would prevent accidents.
purchase-orders endpoint at server.py:572 correctly recalculates reorder qty server-side (max(threshold*2 - qty, threshold)) — frontend cannot manipulate quantities; good.

Frontend api wrapper appears to swallow errors in load() (caught with `catch {}`) on place-order.tsx, catalog.tsx and dashboard — silent failures would only surface as blank screens. Acceptable but a toast on error would improve UX.

Place Order flow: dashboard 'place-order-btn' -> /place-order -> select via 'po-product-<id>' -> 'po-create-btn' -> routes to /(tabs)/orders. Settings testIDs: add-<kind>, edit-<kind>-<id>, del-<kind>-<id>, modal-field-1, modal-field-2 (hidden for categories), modal-save. Catalog sort: catalog-sort-name, catalog-sort-stock. Backend PUT for warehouses/categories/suppliers does not return 404 on missing id (silent no-op + 200) — note when writing future tests.
rca_of_issue: No defects found. All seven review-list features verified working end-to-end in backend pytest + Playwright frontend run. Backend PUT endpoints return the echoed payload on missing id; isolation test confirms no cross-tenant writes occur.
